For those that don't know, from this season 16 Premier League and Championship academies will be competing in the EFL Trophy. This competition was originally played between teams in the bottom 2 tiers of professional football in England.

This decision has caused quite a stir over here. Many lower league fans are annoyed at the decision, this competition was a chance for teams to get to play at Wembley when it would be very unlikely through other competitions such as the FA Cup. It is also seen as further favouritism towards the EPL by the FA. Many clubs opposed this decision and even some EPL sides have pulled out of the competition.

On the other hand, it's supporters say that it will improve England's youth by allowing them to play against better opposition and more regularly. They also say the appeal of big teams like Chelsea will improve attendances and the amount of money lower league sides will get.
